description: Download historical market data for chosen ticker
steps: Run CLI with ticker; verify raw CSV created
expected: Raw CSV with historical OHLCV saved
pass_criteria: CSV exists and contains > 100 rows and no all-NaN columns
notes: Network required; use cached if available

description: Preprocess raw data into training sequences
steps: Run training with --dry-prep or inspect artifacts
pass_criteria: Sequence CSVs created; no NaNs in final feature columns
notes: Check column list includes engineered indicators

description: Run a short training to confirm model runs
steps: Run train for 1-3 epochs on small sample
expected: Model .pt saved and training log printed
pass_criteria: Model file written; loss decreases or completes without crash
notes: Use small epochs for CI speed

command_example: python REWRITE/separated/pytorch_train_cpp.py --ticker AAPL --mode predict --model artifacts/test_run/model.pt --output-root artifacts/test_run
pass_criteria: Predictions file exists and aligns by date with actuals
notes: Inspect head/tail of CSV for date alignment

description: Produce plot comparing actual vs predicted
steps: Run plotting script with produced CSVs
expected: PNG produced showing actual and predicted traces
pass_criteria: PNG exists and visually shows overlayed traces
notes: Verify predicted trace overlaps real-test portion

description: Produce multiple stochastic forecast traces using MC dropout
steps: Run model inference with dropout enabled for N runs (N=50)
expected: mc_forecasts.csv (N runs) and summary stats created
pass_criteria: Multiple forecast traces exist; forecast mean +/- stddev computed
notes: Plot should show spread shading/confidence bands

description: Non-expert can run with CLI flags and help
steps: Run --help and execute canonical one-line example
expected: Help text is clear; example command runs end-to-end
pass_criteria: User can reproduce example with only changing --ticker

description: Single command or wrapper runs download→train→predict→plot
steps: Run scripts/run_example.sh or specified combined command
pass_criteria: All artifacts present and plot created

description: System handles missing days / NaNs gracefully
steps: Simulate missing rows or NaNs in raw CSV then run prep
expected: Preprocessing fills/drops or fails gracefully with warning
pass_criteria: No unhandled exception; either imputed or clear error message
notes: Log file should note imputation strategy

description: CLI returns informative error for unknown ticker
expected: Script exits with non-zero code and human-friendly message
pass_criteria: Exit code != 0 and error text explains failure

expected: Inspect artifact folder for metadata.json or logs
column9: metadata.json or run.log present with git SHA, time
column10: If missing, create simple metadata step in pipeline

description: Setting random seed yields repeatable short-run behavior
expected: Deterministic or near-deterministic loss/outputs across runs
pass_criteria: Key outputs (small run) identical or within tiny tolerance
